description: This file defines the 'tree' class, which manages hierarchical structures within the TestLink project, including creation, traversal, modification, and deletion of tree nodes representing test projects, test suites, test cases, and other related entities.
external_files: // references test plan test case versions
// references test plan test case versions

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Represents a hierarchical structure within the TestLink application, providing methods for node creation, traversal, modification, deletion, and other hierarchical operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the tree object with database handler, setting up internal mappings and default nodes.

methods.name: get_available_node_types
methods.description: Fetches a map of available node types from the database, returning descriptions as keys and IDs as values.

methods.name: new_root_node
methods.description: Creates a new root node in the hierarchy, returning its generated ID.

methods.name: new_node
methods.description: Creates a new node under a specified parent with optional name, order and id.

methods.name: get_node_hierarchy_info
methods.description: Retrieves detailed hierarchy information for a given node or set of nodes.

methods.name: get_subtree_list
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated list or array of node IDs in the subtree starting at a given node.

methods.name: _get_subtree_list
methods.description: Recursively populates a list with all node IDs in the subtree.

methods.name: delete_subtree
methods.description: Deletes all nodes in the subtree starting from a specified node.

methods.name: get_path
methods.description: Returns the path from a node up to the root in specified format.

methods.name: get_path_new
methods.description: Returns a more detailed, potentially recursive path structure from a node to the root.

methods.name: _get_path
methods.description: Internal method recursively retrieving node path in various formats.

methods.name: change_parent
methods.description: Changes the parent of one or multiple nodes.

methods.name: get_children
methods.description: Retrieves the direct children of a node, optionally filtering by node type.

methods.name: change_order_bulk
methods.description: Updates the order of multiple nodes based on provided array.

methods.name: change_child_order
methods.description: Repositions a child node to top or bottom among siblings.

methods.name: getBottomOrder
methods.description: Returns the maximum 'node_order' value among children of a parent node.

methods.name: get_subtree
methods.description: Retrieves all nodes in a subtree, with various filtering options and recursive control.

methods.name: _get_subtree
methods.description: Internal method fetching subtree nodes in a non-recursive manner.

methods.name: _get_subtree_rec
methods.description: Internal method fetching subtree nodes recursively, building a nested structure.

methods.name: get_full_path_verbose
methods.description: Returns detailed path descriptions for a set of nodes, with options for format and output detail.

methods.name: nodeNameExists
methods.description: Checks for existence of another node with the same name and type under the same parent, optional exclusion of a node ID.

methods.name: getTreeRoot
methods.description: Retrieves root node ID for given node.

methods.name: delete_subtree_objects
methods.description: Recursively deletes all objects/nodes in a subtree starting from a node, excluding the subtree root.

methods.name: createHierarchyMap
methods.description: Creates a visual hierarchy map from an array of nodes, with options for dotted or array output.

methods.name: getAllItemsID
methods.description: Recursively finds all item IDs under specific parent nodes, filtered by target and container types.

methods.name: getNodeByAttributes
methods.description: Fetches nodes matching specific attribute filters.

methods.name: getNodeType
methods.description: Retrieves node type info (id and description) for a given node ID.

methods.name: getNameL2
methods.description: Constructs a label combining node names in a two-level hierarchy for a given node ID.
